_comment: One spoken quip per story for the week's Reel (scripts/ig-reel.py). Real spellings; the script applies the LEXICON's TTS respellings itself. Keep each under about fifteen words — it is said and shown.
intro: Eighteen things in South Knoxville this weekend. Here they are, fast.
outro: That's the weekend. The whole briefing is at soknoear.com. Link in bio.

quips.kerns-fall-fest: Line dancing, a School of Rock set and a free Fall Festival on the Kern's lawn, Sunday two to four.
quips.pup-o-ween-hiwire: Dogs in costume walk a runway at Hi-Wire Sunday. The runway is at three.
quips.goodbye-june-808: Goodbye June and Danny Worsnop, a blues-rock double bill at The 808, Friday at seven.
quips.all-my-exes-808: All My Exes Live in Texas turns The 808 into a classic-country dance hall Saturday.
quips.first-bass-pink-cactus: Ten DJs on two stages at the Pink Cactus Saturday, eight till one.
quips.quiet-entertainer-fbn: Quiet Entertainer warms up a Nashville album release at Fly by Night Saturday night.
quips.disco-demon-fbn: Disco Demon Ahun plays funky disco and house at Fly by Night Thursday, five dollars.
quips.ktc-run-printshop: A three-mile social run leaves Printshop Thursday at six. Dollar wings after.
quips.trailhead-crawdaddy: Crawdaddy Jones on the Trailhead patio, Friday at seven.
quips.trailhead-greg-horne: Greg Horne closes the weekend on the Trailhead patio, Sunday at four.
quips.kerns-hoedown-social: The Ho'Down Social: four hours of line dancing at Kern's, Friday from seven thirty.
quips.starlight-paddle: Guided kayaks on the river after dark at Ijams Nature Center, Friday and Saturday at seven.
quips.bluegrass-jam-quarry: A free bluegrass jam fills Mead's Quarry Sunday, two to five. Beginners first.
quips.fall-fungi-id: Learn to read mushrooms on a fungi walk at Ijams Nature Center, Sunday at one.
quips.storytime-birds: Birds take over the free storytime at the Nature Playscape, Saturday at ten.
quips.scruffycat-ride: ScruffyCat sends mountain bikers on a hundred miles of Knoxville trail, Saturday from McClure Lane.
quips.catalyst-adaptive-ride: Catalyst Sports' adaptive mountain bike ride rolls out of Baker Creek Saturday at nine thirty.
quips.specials-board: Earl's runs its Vols board for Alabama on Saturday. Kickoff is three thirty.
